chunks: It was narrated to me by Ali ibn Ahmad from his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abdillah from his father from Muhammad ibn Khalid from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar from al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said:
Two rakat prayer prayed with perfume is superior to seventy rakat prayer offered without perfume.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward of praying with perfume compared to praying without it?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq to illustrate how external beauty (zakhir) reflects and enhances internal reverence (khushu) during prayer. This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on the holistic nature of worship, where physical adornment serves as a tangible expression of honoring the Divine Presence, making the act of prayer a complete sensory experience rather than merely a ritualistic obligation.
